LoveSac (LOVE) is a premium furniture retailer operating more than 250 showrooms across the United States, generating approximately $700 million in annual revenue.

We have obtained a database containing 1,113,285 order records spanning nearly seven years of transactions, from December 2019 through October 2026, with a combined recorded transaction value exceeding $1.62 billion.

Each record contains detailed customer and transaction information, including full customer names, complete billing and shipping addresses, telephone numbers, order numbers, order dates, order statuses, and order grand totals.

Glückauf-Vermessung GmbH (glueckauf-vermessung.de) is a German engineering and technical company based in Sondershausen, operating as part of the ERCOSPLAN Group and specializing in surveying and mine surveying (Bergbau-Markscheiderei). Its core business activities include geodetic support for the mining industry, geological exploration, and work related to salt and mineral deposits. The company provides services for surface and underground measurements, deformation monitoring, and the preparation of technical documentation for industrial projects.

Miletic GmbH is a German specialized contractor headquartered in Bad Schönborn that has been operating in the construction sector since 1989. The company's core business focuses on construction and repair work for ecologically sensitive industrial facilities, including gas stations, tank farms, and operations governed by German water protection laws (WHG Class LAU facilities). Its service portfolio includes joint sealing and remediation, the application of chemical-resistant protective coatings, concrete construction, and related earthworks.

Edelstahl-Mechanik GmbH is a German manufacturing company based in Göppingen. The company specializes in laser metal processing, including 2D and 3D laser cutting and welding, as well as structural sheet metal fabrication. Its products and services are applied in industries such as mechanical engineering, the automotive sector, construction, medical technology, and the food industry.
